title: CXAI Expands Agentic AI Reach into Mid-Market Through EngineRoom's Simpro Partnership
summary: CXAI expands agentic AI into the mid-market via EngineRoom’s Simpro partnership, a potential channel to 24,000+ businesses and 450,000 users.
body_markdown:
***EngineRoom showcases AI-powered revenue growth solutions at Simprosium Sydney, opening opportunities across a global ecosystem of more than 24,000 businesses and 450,000 users***


**PALO ALTO, CA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 18, 2026 /**[CXApp Inc.](https://pr.report/tpcm) (NASDAQ:CXAI) ("CXAI" or the "Company"), an enterprise agentic AI platform company, today highlighted the expansion of its mid-market growth strategy through its Australian subsidiary EngineRoom's technology partnership with Simpro Group, a global leader in AI-powered field service management software. EngineRoom, powered by CXAI, showcased its AI-powered growth intelligence platform at Simprosium Sydney 2026, held November 9-10, at an event that drew more than 750 Simpro customers. EngineRoom extends the Company's AI capabilities into customer acquisition and revenue growth for mid-market businesses.


*EngineRoom, powered by CXAI, showcasing its AI-powered growth intelligence platform at Simprosium Sydney 2026.*


**


**


**AI-Powered Growth Intelligence for the Mid-Market**


**Automating customer acquisition and revenue opportunities**


EngineRoom demonstrated how its platform transforms completed Simpro job data into marketing content that showcases expertise, improves visibility across Google and AI-powered search, and helps businesses attract new customers.


**Connecting marketing investment directly to revenue**


By integrating marketing activity with Simpro's customer, job and revenue data, EngineRoom enables businesses to measure marketing ROI, identify higher-performing channels and make more informed growth investments. EngineRoom's two sessions, "Win more work from jobs you've already finished" and "Know which marketing makes you money. Stop paying for what doesn't," were led by Lawrence Penn, Head of Growth & Partnerships at EngineRoom.


*"Trade businesses are sitting on enormous, untapped growth potential in the data they already have. By connecting EngineRoom's growth marketing technology and AI capabilities with Simpro's operational data, we're helping businesses turn completed jobs into new customer opportunities, understand which marketing investments generate revenue, and make smarter decisions that drive measurable growth. Simprosium was a fantastic opportunity to demonstrate how connected technology and AI can deliver real commercial value," said*[Adam Laurie](https://pr.report/tpcn) *, **General Manager, CXAI Australia** .*


**Scaling Distribution Through a Global Technology Ecosystem**


EngineRoom is a service partner of Simpro Group and an integrated app in the Simpro Marketplace. Simpro Group supports more than 24,000 trade and service businesses and 450,000 users worldwide through its Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange and ClockShark platforms. This established ecosystem represents a potential channel for CXAI to expand awareness and adoption of EngineRoom's growth intelligence solutions in the trade and field service vertical.


The partnership continues with a joint webinar on November 19, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. AEDT. EngineRoom's Lawrence Penn will join Delight by Simpro and Simpro executives Ludi Wiggins, Growth Director APAC, and William Dinkel, VP and GM Engineering, to demonstrate automated repeat-work opportunities and marketing attribution. Registration is open at:[simprogroup.com/resources/webinars/automated-growth-with-delight](https://pr.report/tpco) .


**Continued Mid-Market Commercial Engagement**


EngineRoom will also showcase its platform at The Business Show Australia on November 25-26, 2026, at ICC Sydney, stand B1236, as it continues to build awareness among mid-market businesses. Visit[The Business Show Australia](https://pr.report/tpcp) for event details.


*"Our acquisition of EngineRoom was a strategic step in expanding CXAI's agentic AI capabilities beyond the enterprise and into the mid-market," said*[Khurram Sheikh](https://pr.report/tpcq) ***, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of CXAI** . "By leveraging established industry ecosystems such as Simpro, we see an opportunity to scale customer acquisition, expand our addressable market and drive new revenue opportunities. Our focus is on delivering AI solutions that translate business intelligence into measurable commercial outcomes."*


**About CXApp Inc.**


CXApp Inc. is an enterprise agentic AI platform company focused on helping organizations improve productivity, automate workflows and enhance business performance through artificial intelligence.


The Company's platform combines operational intelligence, analytics, workplace technologies and intelligent automation to deliver measurable business outcomes across enterprise and mid-market organizations.


CXAI serves customers across technology, financial services, healthcare, media and other industries while expanding its AI capabilities through both organic growth and strategic acquisitions.


[www.cxapp.com](https://pr.report/tpcr)
CXApp Inc.:marketing@cxapp.com


About EngineRoom


Founded in 2013, EngineRoom, powered by CXAI, is a technology-driven growth marketing business that combines proprietary software, AI-powered intelligence and expert advisory to help businesses achieve measurable growth.


EngineRoom’s integrated platform connects marketing, customer and operational data to provide greater visibility into marketing performance, measure return on investment, identify growth opportunities and drive smarter business decisions.


EngineRoom is a registered Simpro Group partner, with an integration available through the Simpro Marketplace. EngineRoom was acquired by CXAI in June 2026.[www.engineroom.com.au](http://www.engineroom.com.au/)
